name: Hero section
looksLike: big headline and main button at the start of a page
large introduction area above everything else
opening section with a bold message and a picture
definition: A prominent introductory section near the top of a page, usually containing a headline, supporting text, and a main action.
whenToUse: Explaining a service on a landing page

notConfusedWith.difference: Provides navigation links rather than the main introductory message.

prompts.short: Add a hero section with a clear headline and a prominent action link.
prompts.detailed: Add a responsive hero section with the page heading, brief supporting text, and a descriptive action link. Keep text readable over any imagery, hide decorative visuals from screen readers, and stack content on narrow screens. Give the action visible focus and a 44px target.
